description: The core Hlido trust query: is a specific AI agent trustworthy? Given one agent (by Hlido slug or product/homepage URL) it returns the independent Laddoo trust score (0-100), tier (VITAL/STEADY/FADING/FLATLINE), a one-line verdict, a claim-verification summary, and any known incidents. Call this FIRST — before delegating to, installing, or relying on another agent — to get a fast trust read. Returns no_review_found if the agent isn't in Hlido's corpus (then call request_quick_audit). For the full claim-by-claim evidence, follow up with get_scorecard.

agent_or_url.description: The agent to check: either its Hlido slug (e.g. 'aider', 'cursor') or its product/homepage URL (e.g. 'https://cursor.com'). A URL is matched to the closest reviewed agent.

use_case.description: Optional. The task you're considering this agent for (e.g. 'multi-file TypeScript refactor'); tailors the verdict to that use case when provided.

name: trust_check
